title: Tri-Region GPU Supply Scenario Lanes Q3 2026
abstract: Working worksheet for three explicit supply 'lanes' (Base / Acceleration / Stress) across NA / EU / APAC. Purpose: provide an ops-friendly forecast that maps GPU counts to utilization bands, explicit runway (weeks), and quantifiable trigger thresholds for rollout and procurement. Not final; intended to feed Dedicated capacity tranche planning and cloud-zone procurement windows.
rollout_timeline: 2026-04 to 2026-05: Validate procurement lead-times with cloud vendors; confirm H100 shipment windows for NA pockets.
2026-05 to 2026-06: Execute Acceleration lane for NA (add A100 capacity + preemptible burst slots). Target live by 2026-06-15.
2026-06 to 2026-07: EU staging: bring online A100 80GB in two zones; enable cross-zone failover plumbing and traffic shaping.
2026-07 to 2026-08: APAC backfill: prioritize L4 placements for low-latency gen tasks; hold H100 add until telemetry confirms model mix shift.
2026-09: Dry-run Stress lane: run synthetic load for 72h in NA and EU to verify autoscaling and KV cache invariants.
On-trigger: If any region crosses its trigger_condition, Operations run the corresponding lane checklist within 72h.
Hard deadlines: procurement orders for Q4 capacity must be placed by 2026-08-05 to meet Q4 delivery window.
triggers_and_playbook: Trigger: avg-weekly-util>threshold for N consecutive weeks. Action: Open capacity incident -> ops lead assigns zone owner and procurement rep.
Trigger: per-zone-availability degrades to <2 healthy zones. Action: shift traffic to alternate region margins and start 'Burst Reserve' allocation for latency-critical routes.
Trigger: billing spikes / unexpected committed spend > 12% over baseline. Action: throttle background batch jobs and engage finance to validate budget headroom.
Playbook note: For Acceleration lane we prefer cloud burst or spot pools with pre-warmed instances (warm-up window 6-12 hours) to avoid cold-start P99 latency cliffs.
assumptions: Model mix shifts: 40% gen-chat, 35% embeddings, 25% reranking/latent workloads across next 12 months.
Average tokens per request increases by 12% in stress scenario (longer context adoption).
KV cache effectiveness reduces per-token work by 20% on average; assumed for Base lane but degrades in Stress by ~8%.
Lead times: H100 procurement lead 6-10 weeks (cloud vendor window), A100 4-8 weeks, L4 immediate (1-2 weeks).
Cloud preemptible/spot availability has ~15% variance (spike events) and should not be counted towards runway without fallbacks.
action_items: Aisha: confirm final vendor SLAs and itemize lead-times by zone (due 2026-04-09).
Jonas: run a calibrated synthetic load (NA) for the Stress lane and produce telemetry (due 2026-05-20).
Miguel: update capacity dashboard to include 'lane' column and alerting for trigger thresholds (due 2026-04-30).
Priya: negotiate provisional discounts for Acceleration buys and create PO template (due 2026-05-01).
notes_to_self: This sheet should be the canonical 'ops playbook' for triage — keep concise and avoid duplicate copies.
Open question: whether to express capacity as GPU-count or as normalized 'vGPU compute units' for multi-fleet (H100 vs L4). Decision pending infra-telemetry input.
Follow up with Product (evals) to get expected token growth per workload; current 12% is a conservative placeholder.
Remember: cross-region replication for model weights increases network egress; include bandwidth cost estimate in next revision.
